engagement.authorization: User-stated explicit authorization to test the pollinations/pollinations open-source repository (github.com/pollinations/pollinations). All testing is performed against a LOCAL CLONE of the upstream source in this VM and against loopback-only mock services. No traffic is sent to any live pollinations.ai production endpoint, no production data is accessed, and no harmful action is taken against the platform or its users.
engagement.operator_note: Report-only, defensive security research. PoCs are minimal, local, non-destructive, and never fired at production.

out_of_scope: pollinations.ai production accounts, keys, and data
third-party APIs (OpenAI, Stripe, Replicate, etc.) beyond local mocks
denial-of-service or resource-exhaustion attacks against production
any action affecting real users, payments, or balances
